header.generation_method: AI-assisted manual analysis of exact source snapshots and primary publisher records, with deterministic hashing and validation
header.prepared_by: OpenAI Codex, at Igor Barshteyn's request
header.validity: Current overlay source at the projector-installer update with unchanged tested stock baseline; supplied licensing package 2.0 retains its earlier reviewed source identifiers. Installed artifacts, license adoption and deployment compliance are not attested.

scope.included: R26.1 overlay, tested stock base, declared reference native runtime, seven model roles, first-level dependencies, mutable data categories, permissions and conditional flows.
scope.excluded: Actual installed binaries/weights/configuration, private memory/image/log contents, full transitive OS/build closure, supplier training internals, unconfigured alternate models/services, and subjective-consciousness/compliance judgments.

views.reachable: statically described native actions conditional on config/permissions; not an exhaustive reachability proof

zones.name: Physical environment
zones.note: Microphone/camera inputs and emitted audio cross into or out of physical surroundings.

zones.name: Native brain process
zones.note: Logical processing zone; native modules share process privileges, not independent security sandboxes.

zones.name: Local speech processes and loopback
zones.note: Separate processes on one host. Loopback binding does not authenticate other local processes.

zones.name: Local mutable stores and IPC
zones.note: No blanket assertion of encryption, access isolation or automatic deletion.

zones.name: OS, devices and shared runtimes
zones.note: Loaded libraries, GPU stack and device permissions are deployment-specific.

zones.name: Launcher administration
zones.note: Privileged host tuning belongs to launch scripts, not a model-selected arbitrary command tool.

zones.name: Local installation and conversion
zones.note: Optional Python exporter is outside native runtime.

zones.name: External suppliers and lineage
zones.note: Downloaded source/models/package metadata; upstream training internals have limited visibility.

behaviors.triggers: Native events and default 10 Hz controller tick; environment can override tick rate.
behaviors.permissions: Native implementation dispatches eligible actions; proposals do not create camera or retention permission.
behaviors.limits: Sustained is default in mode_setting; legacy/shadow are alternatives. Existing gates, elapsed-time pacing and human-first arbitration apply.

behaviors.triggers: Permitted quiet windows; dream eligibility after configured idle/absence threshold.
behaviors.permissions: No independent shell/network authority; results return through controller product gates.
behaviors.limits: Shared decode mutex, bounded prompt/generation, cancellation/epoch ownership. Default dream threshold 1800 s; README example sets 420 s.

behaviors.triggers: Eligible explicit request or controller initiative.
behaviors.permissions: Camera grants, revocation and image-retention permissions evaluated in native code; OS camera access also required.
behaviors.limits: Reference launcher --look-max 15 and --recall-max 6; 20 s capture deadline by default. Feature overrides can alter behavior.

behaviors.triggers: Accepted conversations, relevant recall, rolling/exit consolidation.
behaviors.permissions: Filesystem access as runtime OS user; source/ownership checks are application logic.
behaviors.limits: Reference --memory-words 2048; bounded retrieval and source-preserving transformations. No embedding server or vector database declared.

behaviors.triggers: Accepted speech work in native file protocol.
behaviors.permissions: Loopback endpoint, IPC directory and playback-device rights of local user; native client --api and --play are operator configuration.
behaviors.limits: Cancellation/partial delivery retained; HTTP paths use explicit 120/300 s timeouts. No per-user API key or provider quota in local reference endpoint.

behaviors.permissions: OS account and configured sudo authority; separate from model action selection.
behaviors.limits: Local configuration and recovery policies; not a general-purpose model-controlled command execution agent.

behaviors.role: operator-run build/install acquisition; not autonomous runtime behavior
behaviors.triggers: Normal full install or explicit --vision-model-only; --skip-vision-model disables default acquisition/checks.
actions: verify and reuse a matching existing file
download/resume the pinned projector if needed
publish without overwriting a concurrently created destination
behaviors.permissions: Operator filesystem/network authority; no sudo, camera activation, camera permission grant or automatic retained-launcher replacement.
behaviors.limits: Source-only/check/dry-run modes do not download. --check verifies by default; --check-sources and --skip-build do not inspect weights. Hash-specific partial, symlink and partial hard-link checks, HTTPS-only redirects. Model/partial files are outside source rollback.

gaps.title: Installed artifact identity
gaps.finding: All model weights, binaries and libraries are unobserved on the target machine.
gaps.closure: Capture local SHA-256, file sizes, active paths, native build IDs and resolved revisions.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Unpinned external llama.cpp and package closure
gaps.finding: TTS llama-server checkout and optional pip environment float; OS/transitive libraries have no lock or installed inventory.
gaps.closure: Record exact installed commits, package manifest and native linked-library SBOM.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Projector deployment matching and live integration
gaps.finding: Missing reference acquisition is resolved: current overlay pins publisher revision, size and SHA-256. Actual installed bytes, active --mmproj selection, custom replacements and live vision behavior remain unobserved.
gaps.closure: Check the installed file against the pinned size/hash (or independently document a custom artifact), verify the active launcher/model pairing and camera permissions, and retain live target-machine vision evidence.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: License adoption and historical-rights reconciliation
gaps.finding: Supplied package 2.0 provides identical operative terms and project-specific notices/scopes for both repositories. Missing-text aspect is resolved; actual adoption commits, historical grants and rights coverage remain unverified. Original commits are pre-adoption snapshots. The newer installer/README commit does not supply root licensing adoption files; supplied v2.0 scope documents still identify the earlier reviewed source.
gaps.closure: Record each actual authorized adoption commit and reviewed contribution scope; reconcile current README and preserve earlier grants. Do not substitute the pre-adoption commits as adoption identifiers.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Orpheus license lineage
gaps.finding: Publisher/quantizer cards label Apache-2.0; those cards name Llama 3.2 ancestry and stock README names community terms. Supplied v2.0 model review reports a maintainer distinction between Apache repository code and Llama-licensed weights; exact checkpoint rights remain unresolved.
gaps.closure: Resolve the actual checkpoint/quantization license chain; preserve applicable agreement, AUP, Meta notices and Built with Llama display where required. Do not treat Athena v2.0 or an Apache card label as weight clearance.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: emotion2vec export provenance and rights
gaps.finding: Alias is mapped by inspected FunASR code, but installed version, exact source checkpoint, export strategy/log and ONNX bytes are missing. Card uses custom model-license.
gaps.closure: Retain resolved checkpoint/config, custom terms, conversion package lock, export log and produced ONNX digest. Review model attribution/name, scope and revision clauses separately; noncommercial operation is not automatic clearance.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Training corpus visibility
gaps.finding: Exact supplier datasets, snapshot hashes, item rights, split/contamination information and training jobs are not available.
gaps.closure: Request supplier disclosures; retain unknown status where unavailable.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Runtime configuration and interaction evidence
gaps.finding: No active environment, startup feature report, permissions, endpoints or time-bounded trace supplied.
gaps.closure: Capture a sanitized deployment record and actual interaction evidence before calling this an operational AIBOM.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Evaluation evidence
gaps.finding: Public documents report tests, but raw reports/datasets are absent and target GPU/audio/camera acceptance remains unverified here. Current README reports 34 local projector/installer regression tests and a live publisher download/checksum/reuse test, while explicitly excluding the development tooling from the repository. These maintainer-reported results were not independently reproduced; they are not camera/GPU inference tests.
gaps.closure: Attach source-bound raw reports and live acceptance results; do not treat upstream benchmark tables as Athena metrics.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Integrity and approval
gaps.finding: File hashes are present, but no maintainer approval, signature, build attestation or model signature is asserted.
gaps.closure: Maintainer records review and signs release/attestation with controlled keys if desired.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Data governance
gaps.finding: User memory/images/logs, legal bases, retention, filesystem permissions and encryption are deployment-specific and unobserved.
gaps.closure: Document operator decisions privately; publish only redacted metadata, never personal stores.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: Whisper license metadata discrepancy
gaps.finding: Selected GGML distribution declares MIT; original GitHub project uses MIT; Transformers model card labels Apache-2.0.
gaps.closure: Preserve selected artifact license and source notices; resolve any redistribution of a different format separately.
gaps.owner: Maintainer or deploying operator; supplier for undisclosed upstream data

gaps.title: License notice, assent and contracting authority
gaps.finding: Version 2.0 documents are present; no controlled installer/provisioning acceptance implementation, executed record or institutional authority evidence was supplied.
gaps.closure: Implement/test conspicuous exact-version assent where section 5.6 applies; retain private text/hash, presentation, time/action and capacity/authority evidence. Guest conversation is not operator assent.
gaps.owner: Maintainer and relevant distributor/operator; qualified counsel where needed

gaps.title: Actual attribution and installed-tree notice propagation
gaps.finding: Both project notices are supplied, but their propagation to installed/binary bundles and accessible shared or voice-only credits has not been demonstrated.
gaps.closure: Verify actual distribution contents, inherited notices, both project credits and accessible attribution; complete release-matched third-party/model notice set for any shipped artifacts.
gaps.owner: Maintainer and relevant distributor/operator; qualified counsel where needed

gaps.title: Use-specific lawful-deployment and welfare controls
gaps.finding: Documentary obligations under sections 6-8 do not establish implemented safeguards, proportionate testing, user disclosures, legal compliance or subjective consciousness.
gaps.closure: Record actual audience/locations/purpose, applicable rules and tested controls; keep proportionate research and data-governance evidence private. Suspend affected access where a required prerequisite is absent.
gaps.owner: Maintainer and relevant distributor/operator; qualified counsel where needed

gaps.title: Contribution ownership and historical grant boundaries
gaps.finding: Neither package supplies a completed line-level title/rights audit, full prior-release/private-archive history or all contributor authority. Repository ownership and filenames are not sufficient.
gaps.closure: Establish licensor-controlled expression, upstream/earlier permissions and authorized contributor grants; retain specific notices without asserting exclusive rights over whole mixed-origin files.
gaps.owner: Maintainer and relevant distributor/operator; qualified counsel where needed
